pairs.why: Both rockets are rendered almost the same, but B has small rivets on the nose cone, like the riveted submarine, so it reads more like a built object.
This is the same pair with the sides swapped: A has the riveted nose cone and B is plainer and slightly more like a glossy statue.
B's rivets and seam detail on the nose match the real cards' built-object detail, while A's plain shell looks slightly more like a toy statue.
A has the riveted nose seam, which gives it the built construction of the real cards; B is a smoother, plainer version of the same rocket.
The two rovers are almost identical, but B's deck panel plate gives slightly more built detail without adding surface texture.
This is the same pair swapped: A has the deck panel detail, which makes it read slightly more like a built object.
